- **Case file:** the Notes line says Thursday is "Spotify/Conde Nast", but the Description table says Spotify / Sony Pictures / Ralph Lauren. I followed the Description table and flagged the mismatch in the report.

No bugs were filed and nothing was mutated. I did no skill or registry maintenance, as instructed.
